rationale: C08 plausibly supplied a material drafting template. It uses the same emergency-board framework, the same three regional Carriers' Conference Committees, an attached List A organized into Eastern, Western, and Southeastern regions, and virtually identical findings/reporting and section 10 status-quo provisions. Its carrier roster also substantially overlaps the child's roster. C22 is especially close in naming the same three conference committees and the Order of Railway Conductors, but lacks the attached regional carrier list. C07 strongly parallels the list machinery and the phrase applying the status-quo command to 'any of the carriers involved,' but is less proximate and uses a different description of the represented carriers.

shared_material.explanation: Distinctive near-verbatim identification of the represented carriers and incorporation of an attached list.
